item.title: NSSA To Raise Monthly Pension Payouts By Nearly 30% From October
item.description: NSSA Confirms New Monthly Pension Payments For October 2026 Zimbabwean pensioners and beneficiaries under NSSA’s mandatory social protection schemes are set for higher monthly payments from 1 October 2026, with the biggest increase taking the baseline pension from US$70 to US$90. #Zimbabwe #Business #ZimbabweEconomy #ZimbabweNews
item.dc:creator: Iharare News

item.title: NSSA to raise monthly pension payouts by 30pc @zimsituation
item.description: Business Reporter THE National Social Security Authority (NSSA) will raise monthly pension payouts across its mandatory social protection schemes by nearly 30 percent, effective October 1, a senior official has said. NSSA general manager Dr Charles Shava confirmed the planned upw #Zimbabwe #Business #ZimbabweEconomy #ZimbabweNews
